items.title: John "Knocky" Parker Interview, 1963-08-28
items.q: I went to Los Angeles and started working with Zuta Singleton, Albert Nicholas and Vic Dickinson at the little old Cobra Club.

ctx.x: What happened after that? That is, after you came out of the service?

I went to Los Angeles and started working with Zuta Singleton, Albert Nicholas and Vic Dickinson at the little old Cobra Club. I was the only white musician in the band, of a Negroes in a section of Los Angeles, that was then involved in dispute between the recently released Japanese and the Negroes who had taken over during their internment. And the Board of Equalization had me leave the group. I was the only white man there, they were worried about it. And I went off to Reno, working as a soloist at some little…
You joined the faculty at the University of Nevada at that time?
